50: impl ChecksumPrinter {
51:     fn write_digest_line(
52:         &mut self,
53:         spec: &ChecksumFormatSpec,
54:         filename: &Path,
55:         sum_hex: String,
56:     ) -> UResult<()> {
57:         let style = &spec.presentation;
58:         let mode = &style.encoding;
59:         let size_info = &mode.path_info;
60:         let input_kind = &size_info.source;
61: 
62:         if mode.raw {
63:             let bytes = match spec.algo_name {
64:                 ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC => sum_hex.parse::<u32>().unwrap().to_be_bytes().to_vec(),
65:                 ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV | ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD => {
66:                     sum_hex.parse::<u16>().unwrap().to_be_bytes().to_vec()
67:                 }
68:                 _ => hex::decode(sum_hex).unwrap(),
69:             };
70:             stdout().write_all(&bytes)?;
71:             self.emitted_raw = true;
72:             return Ok(());
73:         }
74: 
75:         let sum = if mode.base64 {
76:             match spec.algo_name {
77:                 ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC | ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV | ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD => sum_hex,
78:                 _ => encoding::encode(encoding::Format::Base64, &hex::decode(sum_hex).unwrap())
79:                     .unwrap(),
80:             }
81:         } else {
82:             sum_hex
83:         };
84: 
85:         let not_file = input_kind.from_stdin;
86:         let sz = size_info.byte_count;
87:         let blocks = (sz + size_info.output_bits - 1) / size_info.output_bits;
88:         // The BSD checksum output is 5 digit integer
89:         let bsd_width = 5;
90:         match (spec.algo_name, not_file) {
91:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV, true) => println!("{} {}", sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(), blocks),
92:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV, false) => println!(
93:                 "{} {} {}",
94:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
95:                 blocks,
96:                 filename.display()
97:             ),
98:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD, true) => println!(
99:                 "{:0bsd_width$} {:bsd_width$}",
100:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
101:                 blocks
102:             ),
103:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD, false) => println!(
104:                 "{:0bsd_width$} {:bsd_width$} {}",
105:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
106:                 blocks,
107:                 filename.display()
108:             ),
109:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC, true) => println!("{sum} {sz}"),
110:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC, false) => println!("{sum} {sz} {}", filename.display()),
111:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B, _) if style.tagged => {
112:                 if let Some(length) = spec.length {

114:                     println!("BLAKE2b-{} ({}) = {sum}", length * 8, filename.display());
115:                 } else {
116:                     println!("BLAKE2b ({}) = {sum}", filename.display());
117:                 }
118:             }
119:             _ => {
120:                 if style.tagged {
121:                     println!(
122:                         "{} ({}) = {sum}",
123:                         spec.algo_name.to_ascii_uppercase(),
124:                         filename.display()
125:                     );
126:                 } else {
127:                     let prefix = if style.asterisk { "*" } else { " " };
128:                     println!("{sum} {prefix}{}", filename.display());
129:                 }
130:             }
131:         }
132: 
133:         Ok(())
134:     }

137: /// Calculate checksum
138: ///
139: /// # Arguments
140: ///
141: /// * `options` - CLI options for the assigning checksum algorithm
142: /// * `files` - A iterator of OsStr which is a bunch of files that are using for calculating checksum
143: #[allow(clippy::cognitive_complexity)]
144: fn cksum<'a, I>(mut options: Options, files: I) -> UResult<()>
145: where
146:     I: Iterator<Item = &'a OsStr>,
147: {
148:     let files: Vec<_> = files.collect();
149:     if options.output_format == OutputFormat::Raw && files.len() > 1 {
150:         return Err(Box::new(ChecksumError::RawMultipleFiles));
151:     }
152: 
153:     let mut printer = ChecksumPrinter { emitted_raw: false };
154:     for filename in files {
155:         let filename = Path::new(filename);
156:         let stdin_buf;
157:         let file_buf;
158:         let not_file = filename == OsStr::new("-");
159: 
160:         // Handle the file input
161:         let mut file = BufReader::new(if not_file {
162:             stdin_buf = stdin();
163:             Box::new(stdin_buf) as Box<dyn Read>
164:         } else if filename.is_dir() {
165:             Box::new(BufReader::new(io::empty())) as Box<dyn Read>
166:         } else {
167:             file_buf = match File::open(filename) {
168:                 Ok(file) => file,
169:                 Err(err) => {
170:                     show!(err.map_err_context(|| filename.to_string_lossy().to_string()));
171:                     continue;
172:                 }
173:             };
174:             Box::new(file_buf) as Box<dyn Read>
175:         });
176: 
177:         if filename.is_dir() {
178:             show!(USimpleError::new(
179:                 1,
180:                 format!("{}: Is a directory", filename.display())
181:             ));
182:             continue;
183:         }
184: 
185:         let (sum_hex, sz) =
186:             digest_reader(&mut options.digest, &mut file, false, options.output_bits)
187:                 .map_err_context(|| "failed to read input".to_string())?;
188: 
189:         let spec = ChecksumFormatSpec::new(
190:             options.algo_name,
191:             options.length,
192:             options.tag,
193:             options.asterisk,
194:             options.output_format == OutputFormat::Raw,
195:             options.output_format == OutputFormat::Base64,
196:             options.output_bits,
197:             sz,
198:             not_file,
199:         );
200:         printer.write_digest_line(&spec, filename, sum_hex)?;
201:         if printer.emitted_raw {
202:             return Ok(());
203:         }
204:     }
205: 
206:     Ok(())
207: }

244:  * Determine if we had a reset.
245:  * This is basically a hack to support the behavior of cksum
246:  * when we have the following arguments:
247:  * --binary --tag --untagged

251: fn had_reset(args: &[String]) -> bool {
252:     // Indices where "--binary" or "-b", "--tag", and "--untagged" are found
253:     let binary_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--binary" || x == "-b");
254:     let tag_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--tag");
255:     let untagged_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--untagged");
256: 
257:     // Check if all arguments are present and in the correct order
258:     match (binary_index, tag_index, untagged_index) {
259:         (Some(b), Some(t), Some(u)) => b < t && t < u,
260:         _ => false,
261:     }
262: }

292:         None => {
